name: Domaine Gagnard-Delagrange
story: The domaine dates to 1959, when Jacques Gagnard married Marie-Josèphe Delagrange. Most of the vines later passed to their daughters, Laurence and Claudine, of Fontaine-Gagnard and Blain-Gagnard. Grandson Marc-Antonin Blain makes the small remaining core in a traditional style.
